title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures
manuscript_title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures on the line (OpenAI, September 24, 2026)

main_statement.latex:
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}
For every finite nonempty indexed family
$\varphi_i(x)=r_i x+t_i$ on $\R$ with $0<|r_i|<1$, and every
strictly positive probability vector $p$, its self-similar measure satisfies
\[
 \dim_H\mu_{\Phi,p}
 =\min\left\{1,\frac{h_{\mathrm{RW}}(\Phi,p)}{\chi(\Phi,p)}\right\}.
\]
No separation assumption is required; exact overlaps and repeated
generators are allowed.
\end{theorem}
main_statement.paraphrase: For any finite system of contracting similarities of the line (signed, unequal ratios, repeated maps and exact overlaps allowed) and any positive weights, the Hausdorff dimension of the self-similar measure equals the minimum of 1 and the entropy rate of the random walk on composed affine maps divided by the Lyapunov exponent. This is Conjecture 3 of Varju's survey (arXiv 2509.22042), described there as 'wide open'; its no-exact-overlap case is the exact overlaps conjecture (Simon; Hochman) for measures, and Cor 6.3 gives the set version.

headline_corollaries.paraphrase: Exact overlaps conjecture for self-similar measures on R: no exact overlaps implies dim mu = min{1,H(p)/chi}.
Set version: no exact overlaps implies dim_H K = min{1, similarity dimension}.
Homogeneous systems and the Rapaport-Varju three-map family {lambda x, lambda x+1, lambda x+t}: full no-overlap formula for every lambda, t and weights.

relation_to_known_results: Hochman 2014: formula under (weak) exponential separation; this paper needs no separation.
Rapaport 2022: exact overlaps conjecture for algebraic contraction ratios; this paper: arbitrary real ratios.
Breuillard-Varju 2019 + Varju 2019 (Annals): entropy-rate formula for all Bernoulli convolutions (Varju survey Thm 7); recovered as a special case.
Rapaport-Varju 2024 Thm A.1 (rational translations, common positive ratio, overlaps allowed), Feng-Feng 2025 (algebraic translations): special cases.
Baker 2021 / Barany-Kaenmaki 2021: super-exponential condensation without exact overlaps exists, so any proof must be separation-free; this proof never bounds the band endpoints B_n.
Does NOT use Hochman's inverse theorem; only external dimension theorem is Feng-Hu exact dimensionality (re-proved in Lean).

comparators.verbatim: theorem entropy_rate_dimension {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) : lowerHausdorffDimension μ = ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 (S.entropyRate / S.lyapunov))
comparators.readable: For every finite nonempty index type, signed ratios 0<|r_i|<1, positive weights summing to 1, and every probability measure mu on R with mu = sum_i p_i (phi_i)_* mu: inf{dimH E : E measurable, mu E>0} = min(1, h/chi), where h = inf_{n>=1} H_2(law of the complete affine map of n iid symbols)/n and chi = -sum p_i log_2|r_i|.

comparators.verbatim: theorem homogeneous_dimension_direct {ι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (S : System ι) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : ∀ i, S.ratio i = lam) (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) (h : NoExactOverlaps S) : lowerHausdorffDimension μ = ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 (symbolEntropy S / Real.log (1/lam)))

comparators.readable: Attractor = range of the coding map omega -> sum_n (prod_{j<n} r_{omega_j}) t_{omega_n}; no exact overlaps among nonempty words (any lengths) gives compact nonempty attractor, unique similarity dimension s>=0, and dimH = min(1,s). Cor 6.3.

match_check.verdict: Faithful. All three comparator targets match Thm 1.1, Cor 6.4 (and hence 6.5), and Cor 6.3. Challenge definitions are character-identical to Model.lean / NoOverlaps.lean / AttractorFormula.lean.
details: wordAffine (i::w) = phi_i o phi_w computes the full signed affine map; completeMap uses List.ofFn, so G_n is the law of phi_{w_0}o...o phi_{w_{n-1}}, as in the paper.
entropyRate is the infimum over n>=1 (paper shows lim = inf); base-2 entropy and base-2 chi match the paper's convention; ratio is base-free anyway.
SelfSimilar is the fixed-point equation for an arbitrary probability measure; uniqueness is proved in Lean (selfSimilar_unique), so the theorem is not weakened by quantifying over solutions.
lowerHausdorffDimension = inf over measurable E with mu E>0 of Mathlib dimH: matches the paper's lower Hausdorff dimension (Borel sets).
Nonempty iota, positive weights, 0<|r_i|<1: exactly the paper's hypotheses. With one symbol the Lean statement still holds (h=0).

NoExactOverlaps in homogeneous_dimension_direct is injectivity of wordAffine on ALL lists (incl. different lengths and []); equivalent to the paper's same-length convention by Lemma 6.1 and slopes lam^n != 1.
cor_set compares nonempty words of arbitrary lengths; equivalent by Lemma 6.1. The tsum coding point is absolutely summable.
formalized_in_library_but_not_compared: Cor 6.2 general no-exact-overlap measure formula (Extensions.no_exact_overlaps_dimension, NoOverlaps.lean:200)
not_formalized: Nothing from the paper's proof is missing; Feng-Hu exact dimensionality, cited in the paper, is re-proved in Lean rather than assumed.
route_differences_lean_vs_paper: Exact dimensionality proved in-house (Hopf maximal inequality, Birkhoff and Maker triangular averages, maximal ball ratio with integrable log envelope, information rate infoRate) rather than citing Feng-Hu Thm 2.8.

Pair bound proved with shifted 4-adic grids on AddCircle plus an existence-of-good-shift averaging and induction on depth (refinementCost 352k^4/R), rather than independently perturbed cuts; same final C_k = 60000k^4.
Types generalized to an arbitrary slope-fixing tag; the main theorem applies it to the b-block system S.blocks with tag = wordType.
Window count uses a common horizon H divisible by all n_i and T = 2DH (exists_common_horizon), instead of an even T with floor counts.
Homogeneous corollary has an independent 'direct' proof branch with the trivial tag.

proof_architecture.claim: Setup and easy direction: h_RW subadditive; exact dimensionality gives d; regrouping into n-block map alphabets and a covering argument give d <= min{1,h/chi}. Remains: rule out d<1, d chi<h.
Entropy calculus between scales; entropy-dimension bound; uniform nonsaturation delta=inf_v Delta_v(mu)>0 (stopped self-similarity); two-point gain >= Delta_v - s/v - v/t.

Finite-law pair bound: for any finite law, k x (exact minus scale-rho entropy) <= log|kF| + C_k x (pair capacity at all finer bands), independent of minimal separation; proof by randomized nested partitions where revealing the k-fold sum makes refinement cost linear in mean deviations.

Block types fix signed slopes, so conditional translation entropy equals conditional map entropy >= n(bh - m log(b+1)); with dimension loss this exceeds scale-2^{-An} entropy by eps n. Digit-count sumsets are polynomial in k, so the pair bound yields expected pair capacity >= c n in a finite band [a_n, B_n] with B_n uncontrolled.
Suffix laws and window entropy g_j at each target depth L; each fair pair of the window gains (delta/2) after averaging the unobserved future types (Jensen + nonsaturation).

Choose q bands with separated relative depths adaptively; at each physical scale retained windows are disjoint so gains telescope to <= 2 log M; summing over T targets each band contributes delta c T/(4D); q is bounded - contradiction.
Corollaries: overlap lengths, no exact overlaps (H(G_n)=nH(p)), attractor dimension via weights |r_i|^{s*}, homogeneous and three-map cases.

consistency_checks_passed: Consistent with known dimension drops: Pisot Bernoulli convolutions have h_RW < log 2 (Garsia), so the formula predicts the known drop.
Does not overreach to R^d: the argument uses d<1 only through nonsaturation, which fails for measures saturating a subspace - matching the known need for irreducibility in Hochman's R^d theorem.
Consistent with Baker / Barany-Kaenmaki super-exponential condensation: no quantitative separation is used; band endpoints are never bounded.

Entropy bookkeeping: each block has entropy <= b log m, but the contradiction is about multiscale gains at a fixed physical scale (budget 2 log M), not about per-block entropy, so the q-fold accumulation is not a double count.
